name: Chatcone

fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Chatcone → Settings → API (the Open API key)

fields.label: Company ID
fields.description: The workspace id sent as the company_id header on platform calls

fields.label: Channel Key
fields.description: Primary channel key (e.g. your LINE OA channel), used for identity/tag calls

instructionText: Connect your Chatcone workspace with the Open API key from Settings → API and your Company ID. Add a channel key (e.g. your LINE OA channel) to use the contact tagging tool.

website.tagline: Thai omnichannel chat + chatbot — channels, rich menus, and contact tagging
website.description: Connect Chatcone, Thailand's omnichannel chat and AI-chatbot platform (LINE OA, Facebook, Instagram, web widget, marketplaces), to read your channel and rich-menu configuration and taxonomy, and to map and tag contacts against your own customer ids through the official Open API.
useCases: List the channels and rich-menu layouts configured on a workspace
Read the chat-label taxonomy used to segment contacts
Map a LINE or Facebook user to a customer id and tag them

docs.title: Connecting a Chatcone workspace
docs.summary: The API key and Company ID, where each comes from, the per-channel channel key, and the two Chatcone surfaces (Open API v3 and Platform API v2).

docs.title: What the API key can and cannot do
docs.summary: Configuration reads and contact tagging work with an API key; contact lists and message history do not — those need an agent session token or a portal export. New messages arrive via the outbound webhook only.

contextMessage: You have access to Chatcone (Thai omnichannel chat + chatbot). Scope: the API key reads account configuration (channels, rich-menu layouts, chat labels) and can map/tag contacts. It CANNOT list contacts or read past message transcripts — those require an agent session token or a portal export, and new messages arrive only via Chatcone's outbound webhook.

tools.name: chatcone_list_channels
tools.description: List the messaging channels configured on the Chatcone workspace (LINE, Facebook, Instagram, web widget, …) with their ids and active state.

tools.name: chatcone_list_richmenu_layouts
tools.description: List the LINE rich-menu layout catalog available to this workspace — layout ids, sizes, and tap-area geometry.

tools.name: chatcone_list_labels
tools.description: List the chat labels (contact taxonomy) defined on the workspace, used to segment and tag contacts.

tools.name: chatcone_verify_tag
tools.description: Officially supported Open API write: map a LINE user (line_id) or Facebook user (fb_id) to a customer_id and attach system tags. Requires the channel key for the target channel to be configured on the account.

line_id.description: LINE user id to map (provide this or fb_id)

fb_id.description: Facebook user id to map (provide this or line_id)

customer_id.description: Your system's customer id to associate with the contact
